skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic legal regulations regarding business registration and management.
Understand legal regulations concerning private enterprises and companies.
Understand legal regulations concerning various types of companies including limited liability companies, joint-stock companies, and partnerships.
Understand legal regulations concerning state-owned enterprises and other business entities.
Understand legal regulations concerning bankruptcy and dissolution of businesses.
Develop independent research skills and accumulate knowledge.
Demonstrate teamwork skills and ability to work collaboratively.
Demonstrate effective presentation skills and ability to communicate ideas clearly.
Apply critical thinking skills to analyze and solve legal problems.
